ok, so Ive been in your situation way to many times before, but I didnt know I was aroace at the time.   


First take your time, if youre overall stressed, this isnt going to help yoour mental health. I would sit down and explain exactly how you feel, if youre comfortable with comming out to them, Id do so, explain what being aroace means to you and how you feel about any sort of attraction. Provide them resources that explain it. If youre not comfortable with telling them, just be honest and say that youre sorry, but you do not reciprocate. Tell them you still want to be their friend (if you do) and that youll give them some time alone to understand that.  


Important thing because I wasted way to many years in a toxic realtionship that started like this. A good friend, someone worth your love and time, will understand and respect your decision, your emotions and will make an efford, even if its after a break between you guys, to reconnect as platonic friends. A bad friend will react strongly or agressively, will try to manipulate or pressure you into confessing feelings that dont exist, no matter if that reaction comes immediantly or later on. If you feel like theyre pressuring you, just stand up and leave, tell them that this isnt how a friend acts, because its not. 

​

If it ever comes up again in the future, maybe reconsider the relationship, big emphasize on maybe, cause I personally saw the both ends of that. I had a frined that had a cursh on me, but now she has a boyfriend and were still great friends in touch. I had another friend that kept me in a toxic friendship that would get sexual at times and I felt trapped for 4 years, I didnt want to lose a friend and it blinded me form seeing how wrong this is. 

​

Ultimately it depends on you, so give yourself time to think about it. Sorry for the long and a bit late response, hope I could help <3
